title: Prayer, Medicine, and Trust
bullets: When sickness threatens our very life, we can turn to God in prayer, knowing He hears and responds with compassion to our desperate cries.
Using the remedies and knowledge God has placed within our reach—whether medicine or natural healing—is not a lack of faith, but cooperation with our Creator's plan.
We honor God most when we combine fervent prayer with diligent use of every healthy resource available, working as partners with Him in our own restoration.

hymn.title: God Will Take Care of You

prayer: Lord, when sickness comes and my strength fails, help me turn to You in prayer while also receiving the healing gifts You have provided through medicine and nature. Give me the wisdom to trust both Your compassion and the remedies You have placed in my hands.
